prompt: ONE production PNG UI sprite for Catchline. EXACTLY match the shape, colours, outline weight, bevel, shadow and finish of the corresponding piece in the attached mockups. First image is phone service, second arrange, third desktop service. Deliver ONLY: Exact arrange placement CONFIRM: glossy bright green round balloon marker, small downward triangle tail, white inner ring/thin navy outside contour, darker green bottom lip. One bold WHITE CHECK with subtle navy-green stroke, centered. No text, 1:1.12 aspect. Real transparent alpha outside silhouette. Requested export 165x186 or higher intrinsic resolution, retain that aspect. NOT a screenshot, not a full kit, no background world. No lettering or numerals baked in, no watermark or checkerboard. Do not invent extra decoration or use glossy glass/metal. Rounded painted UI finish from references. Frame interiors MUST be smooth uniform cream with only restrained edge shading, no cloudy mottling.
